name: scorp1
description: Turn any business into an advert video: research its website and socials, write the advert in a chosen style, hand back an ElevenLabs voiceover pack, then edit and render to that audio with HyperFrames.

interface.shortDescription: Advert videos for any business, in the style you pick.
interface.longDescription: Give Scorp1 a business's website or social pages. It researches what the business does and how it uses each platform, writes the advert in a style (launch, product, offer, story, proof, how-to or your own), gives you the voiceover script and sound prompts for ElevenLabs, then edits and renders the full video to your audio with music, sound effects, captions and share copy.
defaultPrompt: Make an advert video for this business: <website or Instagram link>
Make a product spotlight advert for <product> from <link>
Render the Scorp1 video, my ElevenLabs files are in audio-in
